🚨 OFFICIAL: Lisandro Martínez releases new statement after meeting with Carrick and club directors.

“Today I met with the club’s leadership and the manager. It was a very positive conversation, where we were able to exchange views and speak openly about what happened after the game”.

“Everyone knows that I am a passionate person and that I live football with great intensity. The frustration of the defeat led me to express how I felt at a time and place that perhaps were not the right ones, and for that I want to apologise”.

“Our club is at its best when we are all united, and I recognise that my words in that moment did not help with that”.

“I know that every single person at Manchester United is doing everything possible to achieve our shared ambition: bringing the success that this club and its supporters deserve”.

“With this situation now behind us, we are fully focused on winning together”.
— Fabrizio Romano (@FabrizioRomano)
